name: dead-player-save-reload
comment: WP-4.7 (PARITY_CHECKLIST P4): a dead player stays in World.playerEntities after it leaves loadedEntityList (Entity.setEntityDead; only World.setEntityDead removes it, World.java:934-945). Night (set_time 18000), difficulty 1, a stone floor y = 60 over x, z -16..16. t=0: the player (id 0) at (0.5, 100, 0.5) holding 10 cobblestone, 3 diamonds and 5 sticks; six pigs (ids 1-6) within 8 blocks of (0, 0), a slime (id 7) at (10.5, 61, 10.5), a zombie (id 8) at (-12.5, 61, -12.5). The player falls 39 blocks (EntityPlayer.fall: 38.x blocks of fallDistance, 35 damage, health -15), drops its inventory (EntityPlayer.onDeath) and leaves loadedEntityList 21 ticks later (deathTime > 20, EntityLiving.java:154-158). After that the world still reads the removed player: World.updateBlocksAndPlayCaveSounds' chunks around it (World.java:1875-1886: rng_state lcg), getClosestPlayerToEntity for the slime's faceEntity every tick (EntitySlime.java:68-75), the zombie's findPlayerToAttack (EntityMob.java:28-31) and the pigs' currentTarget (EntityLiving.java:697-711: one more faceEntity toward the removed player before the isDead test drops it); joinEntityInSurroundings appends it again every 30 ticks (Minecraft.java:1134-1139, World.java:2294-2309), and the next updateEntities removes it. t=95: the slime is moved to y = -80, where Entity.onEntityUpdate kills it (Entity.java:259-261: kill(), not a split, its health is not 0, EntitySlime.java:98-112), so no slime is read back from the save (a loaded slime's constructor draws slimeJumpDelay from the oracle's unseeded Random, census §2). player_state at t = 60 and 99 and inventory at t = 99 read the removed HarnessPlayer object. t=100: save (level.dat's Data.Player is the dead player: Health -15, DeathTime 21, empty inventory; no chunk lines) and reload: spawnPlayerWithLoadedChunks reads it into a new player (Health -15, DeathTime 21), whose first update counts deathTime to 22 and removes it again. t=129: the final save (DeathTime 22). entity_state of every entity and rng_state every tick.
